# Contributing

ScreenOnAuto's source code is not public, but its translations are: the app's text lives in
[`app-strings/`](../app-strings/), and corrections there are welcome as pull requests. See
[app-strings/README.md](../app-strings/README.md) for how to find your language and the rules
a translation has to follow.

For bugs and feature requests, please [open an issue](https://github.com/slzn/ScreenOnAuto-releases/issues).
